name: benchmark-verification-repair
goal: Loop discovery skips incomplete local loop folders instead of blocking template search and verification

evidence: Template search failed when existing local loop folders lacked loop.json; this also broke two pre-existing regression-loop tests.
Unchanged test/loop-discovery.test.ts failed with ExpectedCliError: Loop does not exist before the source repair.
Loop discovery reads loop state directly so its existing missing-file branch can skip incomplete folders.
Same unchanged loop-discovery regression and six existing regression-loop tests pass; no expectations weakened.
Final bun run check passed with one Vitest worker, lower scheduling priority and limited esbuild concurrency. CLI has no affected browser UI path.
